notes.title: Puyo Puyo Grand Prix 2025 Final' & 'Puyo Puyo Ranking Pro-Selection 2025
notes.notes:
Live streaming of the SEGA official tournament 'Puyo Puyo Grand Prix 2025 Final' on Sunday, March 9!

This tournament is a prize money competition featuring a mix of professional and amateur players, consisting of 15 invited players who achieved excellent results in various "Puyo Puyo" tournaments held this year, plus the champion from the 'Puyo Puyo Ranking Pro-Selection 2025 Final Tournament' held at the same venue on the same day, for a total of 16 participants. The champion will be awarded a prize of 1 million yen!

We will also broadcast the SEGA official tournament 'Puyo Puyo Ranking Pro-Selection 2025 Final Tournament' in this stream!!

Don't miss the moment when a new "Puyo Puyo" professional is born, and the moment when the "Puyo Puyo" annual champion is decided!

[Tournament Overview]
SEGA Official Tournament 'Puyo Puyo Ranking Pro-Selection 2025 Final Tournament'

Date: Sunday, March 9, 2025, from 10:00 AM JPT
Venue: SEGA Headquarters, 11F LIGHTHOUSE
Tournament Format: Single elimination tournament with 4 players who advanced from the preliminaries / Victory condition: First to win 10 games
Awards: 
Championship and runner-up will receive certificates
Championship and runner-up will be granted rights to obtain the "Japan e-Sports Pro License (*)" for the "Puyo Puyo" series by the Japan e-Sports Union (JeSU)
The champion will be granted participation rights in the 'Puyo Puyo Grand Prix 2025 Final' held on the same day

Participants: Norasuke, Shakegohan, Yuuki, Retasu

SEGA Official Tournament 'Puyo Puyo Grand Prix 2025 Final'

Date: Sunday, March 9, 2025, from 11:30 AM JPT(tentative)
Venue: SEGA Headquarters, 11F LIGHTHOUSE
Tournament Format:

Preliminaries: All 16 participants will be divided into 4 groups, with league matches within each group. Rankings will be determined by the number of victories, and the top player from each group will advance to the finals. Victory condition: First to win 10 games
Finals: Single elimination tournament with all 4 players who advanced from the preliminaries.
Victory condition: First to win 10 games (20 games for the championship match only)

Awards: Champion will receive a prize of 1 million yen
If a general player wins, they will be granted rights to obtain the "Japan e-Sports Pro License (*)" for the "Puyo Puyo" series by the Japan e-Sports Union (JeSU)

Participants: Rain, Piponeer, Tomokun, delta, An, zyu-den, Yuuki, Ricky, SAKI, Shiyota, Yoda Souma, OT, Yamada, Villain.R, Yoshi100_Aus
Tournament MCs: Erika Ishitobi / Kosuke Hiraiwa
Commentary: Shohei Shibata / Tom / momoken / ALF

notes.title: Compete in the Ultimate Puzzle Match in Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2, available today!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce [i]Puyo Puyo™ Tetris® 2[/i] is now available to purchase on Steam. This exciting action puzzle experience provides a variety of ways for players to showcase their skills, including a multitude of free content that has been added since the console launch last December. 

Steam users will be able to enjoy a slew of flashy features, including:
[list]
[*] An absolutely packed roster of [b]40 playable characters[/b], including the beloved Sonic the Hedgehog, each with their own unique stats and abilities you can carry with you to the robust, RPG-inspired [b]Skill Battle[/b] mode
[*] A variety of different modes supporting traditional and re-imagined ways to play the iconic puzzle games, such as Swap mode and Party mode
[*] An extensive [b]Adventure[/b] mode, featuring a brand-new story that brings together the game’s vibrant cast for endless exploration in overworld maps
[*] A bounty of competitive [b]Online [/b]features, as well as a co-op [b]Boss Raid[/b] mode where you must work together with three players to take down fierce CPU-controlled bosses, and a new [b]Spectator[/b] mode where you can cheer on others battling in Versus and Skill Battle matches
[*] [b]Color vision accessibility features[/b] which include adjustments for color saturation that can be toggled on or off throughout the game
[*] And much, [b]much[/b] more!
[/list]
[b]Limited-time Steam Launch Edition
[/b]
Steam players can also take advantage of the limited-time [b]Steam Launch Edition[/b]! Boost your strategy and give your team a power-up in [i]Puyo Puyo Tetris 2[/i]’s newly added Boss Raid mode or in Skill Battle mode with this pack of rare Item Cards--including three special cards featuring items from the Sonic the Hedgehog series!

[previewyoutube=30pjFGa9GA8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Puyo Puyo Tetris 2[/i] is now available to purchase for $29.99 on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1259790/Puyo_Puyo_Tetris_2/]Steam store page[/url]. For more information, be sure to visit the official website at https://puyo.sega.com/tetris2, and stay tuned to the official Puyo Puyo accounts on [url=https://twitter.com/puyoofficial]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PuyoOfficial]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/puyoofficial/]Instagram[/url] for all the latest.

notes.title: The sequel to the best puzzle game comes to Steam in March
notes.notes:
What happens when you combine a great puzzle game with the perfect puzzle game? You get Puyo Puyo Tetris, an absolutely delightful peanut butter and chocolate-style combination, which managed to make both Puyo Puyo and Tetris even better with a wide array of both standard and combo modes. Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 followed that up on consoles last year with even more content, and now that sequel is finally coming to PC, too.

Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 hits Steam on March 23, 2021. In a press release, Sega says that the Steam version will come with "even more game features, additional characters, and other exciting new content" - likely meaning things like the boss raid mode and Sonic the Hedgehog character that were recently added to all versions of the game in free updates. There'll be a limited-time Steam launch edition with some additional rare item cards to give you an early boost.

If solid versions of both Puyo Puyo and Tetris weren't enough for you, Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 mashes them up in modes that have you swapping back and forth between games, or even putting both types of pieces on a single board. It's got an RPG-style adventure mode, loads of multiplayer options, tutorials, replays, and more.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 dropping onto PC in March
notes.notes:
Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 arrived just in time to see out 2020 on consoles, but PC players sadly didn't get an invite to that particular party. Thankfully, they won't be left out too much longer, as Sega has finally announced a 23rd March release date for the puzzle-adventure sequel on Steam.

As you might imagine, Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 is very much a continuation of the winning formula last seen in 2017's Puyo Puyo Tetris, meaning plentiful block-dropping and blob-matching action spread across a variety of solo and multiplayer modes.

Adventure mode returns for more ridiculous story driven shenanigans, for instance, this time across multiple dimensions and with a new overworld map, and returning favourites such as Versus, Fusion, Swap, Party, and Big Bang are joined by the new RPG-inspired Skill Battle mode - featuring dynamic character-based skills and equippable item cards.

notes.title: Sonic the Hedgehog is joining Puyo Puyo Tetris 2
notes.notes:
Sega is bringing Sonic the Hedgehog to Puyo Puyo Tetris 2, its excellent second crack at everyone's favourite puzzle game.

The iconic blue mascot will be added to the game today via a new update. Three other characters, a boss rush mode, new item cards and more background music are also included.

There's a new music track just for Sonic, too: Tropical Resort - Act 1.
